description: Gobierno de Aragón: telecommunications datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Gobierno de Aragón. Coverage: Gobierno de Aragón. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about telecommunications; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Cobertura móvil real por tecnología en Aragón - Octubre 2025; Cobertura móvil real por tecnología en Aragón - Julio 2025; Centros con disponibilidad de conexión inalámbrica a Internet (WIFI) p. Formats seen: JSON, CSV, XML, HTML, SHEET. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
